value.text: The strengthened real-process test exposed a genuine owner-release race: a process can release its observed lock and exit between owner inspection and stale-lock reread. Early recovery then surfaced a vanished lock as a fatal filesystem error. Treat vanished/pending-delete reread and unlink observations as bounded contention, retain structural faults, and require deterministic regression plus all 24 accepted writes and 25 history records.
